test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding the use of scribers is not correct?

options.text: Do not carry the scriber in your pocket.
Scriber tips are very sharp, so they must be handled with care.
When drawing (scribing) lines, the scriber is used like a pencil.
Cork the tip while using to prevent accidents.

solution:
The correct answer is __Cork the tip while using to prevent accidents.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Scribers__ are essential tools in metalworking for marking lines on workpieces.
 
• They are usually made of hardened steel to ensure durability and precision.
 
• It is not recommended to cork the tip while using, as this would hinder its primary purpose of marking.
 
• Instead, the sharp tips should always be handled with care to avoid injury.
 
• When not in use, it is advisable to store scribers safely to prevent accidents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Safety Tips:**

 
 
• Always inspect the scriber for any damage before use.
 
• Avoid applying excessive force while using the scriber.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Used for marking accurate measurements
 
• Commonly utilized in metalworking and engineering workshops.
